initiative.title: Edit realms from the command line
initiative.body: Aethyrforge's programmatic surface: `openagents realm ...` makes and edits realms through the same routes, SQL rules and forge edit operations as the page, so Claude Code and other agents can build realms. Plan: docs/cli/2026-11-01-openagents-cli-v1.md, 'The realm domain'. Needs the Coax project's cli-account milestone (NIP-98 as the caller).

milestones.title: Make, read and edit a realm from the CLI
milestones.body: List, show, make, edit, batch, shoot and publish.

tasks.title: GET /api/playtest/realms/mine
tasks.body: The caller's realms (player key, account or NIP-98 key): slug, name, rev, published rev, listed, as lines and JSON.
acceptance: a Coax API test covers an owner with realms, one with none, and a guest key

tasks.title: openagents realm list, show, doc, asks, proposals, panes, open, shot
tasks.body: Read verbs over the HTTPS client, signed with NIP-98. `realm shot SLUG OUT.png [--phone]` uses coax/web/shot.coax (headless, muted).
acceptance: openagents realm show everglade prints the spec lines
openagents realm shot <a made realm> out.png writes a lit PNG at 1440x900

tasks.title: openagents realm new, make, revise, switch, ask, move, place, settings, lore, quest, accept, decline, undo, publish, fork, apply
tasks.body: Every edit names a revision (read first, or --rev N); 409 exits 5 with `rev N`. `realm move` merges the move with aethyr/forge/edit.coax's operations. `realm apply SLUG FILE` runs JSON-lines ops, consecutive moves as one save. A cli-journey check like forge-journey: make, move, stale save (exit 5), undo, publish, fork.
acceptance: the cli-journey check passes against staging with a test account
a realm made and edited by Claude Code through the CLI is published and shows the edits in a headless shot
